source: NASA POWER daily point API (MERRA-2 reanalysis)
recipe:
Reproduce one point:
  GET https://power.larc.nasa.gov/api/temporal/daily/point
      ?parameters=T2M_MAX,T2M_MIN,T2M,T2MDEW,PRECTOTCORR,ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN
      &community=AG&longitude=<LON>&latitude=<LAT>
      &start=19810101&end=20241231&format=JSON
No API key. Values of -999.0 are POWER's fill marker and are read as null here.
The same call works for any latitude and longitude on earth, which is the point
of choosing POWER: Brazilian municipal centroids go through this script
unchanged, only the centroid table differs.
spatial_note: POWER is ~0.5 degree MERRA-2, coarser than a county; values are the containing grid cell at the county centroid, not a polygon average
why_power: global coverage, so Illinois and Brazil use one consistent source for cross-scale transfer learning
